title: A phase Ib/II multicenter open-label study evaluating the safety and preliminary efficacy of escalating doses of PXS 5505 for pan LOX/LOXL inhibition in combination with azacitidine in patients diagnosed with Myelodysplastic Neoplasms (MDS) or Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia (CMML)
summary:
The main purpose of the study is to determine the safety profile, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and recommended phase 2 dose (RPTD) of new compound (PXS-5505) in combination with 5 AZA. Furthermore, the efficacy of PXS-5505 in combination with the standard medication using 5-azacitidine (5-AZA) in patients with myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML) will be investigated. 
First experiments on animals and human cells have shown very good results in the formation of red cells in the bone marrow under therapy with the two drugs mentioned above. In this study, a dose finding as well as the verification of the tolerability of the new substance in combination with the standard will now be tested.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1)	Date and sign a written informed consent ahead of any study related procedures after detailed information by the treating physician.
2)	Aged 18 years or older.
3)	Life expectancy of six months or greater.
4)	ECOG ≤ 2
5)	Confirmed established diagnosis of MDS, or myelodysplastic CMML according to the WHO or ICC of Myeloid Neoplasms and Acute Leukemia diagnostic criteria that meet IPSS-R (high, very high), or CPSS (intermediate-2, high) classification.
6)	Transfusion dependency during 16 weeks before Screening.

In case of MDS:
i.	IPSS-R: high or very high with Hb<8.
ii.	Subjects previously categorized as lower risk group for MDS but have now progressed into high risk MDS (according to IPSS-R: high or very high)
iii.	< 20 % BM/PB blasts.
iv.	Ineligible for allogeneic stem cell transplantation at time point of inclusion, but with option for subsequent transplant.
In case of CMML
v.	CPSS: intermediate-2 or high. 
vi.	10-20% BM/PB blasts equivalents.
vii.	Ineligible for allogeneic stem cell transplantation at time point of inclusion, but with option for subsequent transplant.
viii.	White blood cell (WBC) count ≤ 13.000 /µL.
7)	Patients can either be included if having had no prior HMA treatment or prior treatment with a maximum of 6 cycles azacitidine or Decitabine as single substance treatment. Patients with prior treatment with guideline medication such as Lenalidomide, Hydroxyurea, erythropoietin stimulating agents, Ruxolitinib, Cytarabin, Melphalan, Luspatercept or iron chelation can be included if treatment with said substances was stopped at least 28 days before C1D1.
8)	Patients must have adequate liver or renal function defined as: 
•	Serum alanine transaminase (ALT) < 3.0 × upper limit of normal [ULN]
•	Serum aspartate transaminase (AST) < 3.0 × ULN
•	Serum total bilirubin ≤ 2.0 × ULN
Note: Subjects with documented Gilbert's Syndrome may be allowed if total bilirubin > 2.0 × ULN AND 
•	Total white blood cell (WBC) count ≤ 10,000/µL
Note: Treatment with hydroxyurea is permitted to lower the WBC to reach this inclusion criterion. The WBC should be determined ≥ 24 hours after the last dose of hydroxyurea. The last dose of hydroxyurea should not be administered ≤ 3 days prior to the first dose of azacitidine
•	Creatinine clearance ≥ 30 mL/min
9)	Men must agree to use one medically approved (i.e., mechanical or pharmacological) contraceptive measure and have their partners agree to an additional barrier method of contraception for the duration of the study and for 90 days after the last administration of study drug. Women of childbearing potential must use effective contraception. Adequate methods of contraception include use of oral contraceptives or Depo-Provera, with an additional barrier method (diaphragm with spermicidal gel or condoms with spermicide), double-barrier methods (diaphragm with spermicidal gel and condoms with spermicide), partner vasectomy, and total abstinence.
Exclusion criteria:
1)	Any serious medical condition or psychiatric illness that would prevent (as judged by the treating physician) the subject from signing the informed consent form or any condition, including the presence of laboratory abnormalities, which places the subject at unacceptable risk if he/she were to participate in the study or confounds the ability to interpret data from the study.
2)	Any active infection requiring parenteral antibiotic therapy within 28 days prior to enrollment.
3)	Patients who suffered strokes, deep venous thrombosis (DVT), or arterial infarctions within 6 months prior to enrollment.
4)	Patients with history of severe allergic or anaphylactic reactions to any of the components used in the investigational product PXS-5505 or azacitidine.
5)	Known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), active hepatitis C, or active hepatitis B
6)	Active EBV, CMV or other infection (re-screening possible).
7)	Subject has a history of an active malignancy within the past 2 years prior to enrollment, with the exception of: 
i.	Adequately treated in situ carcinoma of the cervix uteri.
ii.	Adequately treated basal cell carcinoma or localized squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.
iii.	Asymptomatic prostate cancer without known metastatic disease and with no requirement for therapy.
iv.	breast carcinoma in situ with no evidence of disease.
8)	Use of any cytotoxic chemotherapeutic agents, corticosteroids (prednisone ≤ 10 mg/day or corticosteroid equivalent is allowed), or immune modulators (e.g., thalidomide, lenalidomide) within 28 days prior to enrollment.
9)	History of surgery within 28 days before enrollment or anticipated surgery during the study period or two weeks post- study. 
10)	History of aneurysm.
11)	 Symptomatic congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Classification, Class II or higher), unstable angina, or unstable cardiac arrhythmia requiring medication.
12)	 Patients with inadequate organ functions that do not fulfill the inclusion criteria Nr. 6.
13)	 Splenectomy
14)	 Pregnancy, breastfeeding, and women actively trying to get pregnant. 
Note: A pregnancy test is performed for all females of child-bearing potential at specified visits. Not being of childbearing potential is defined as: a) Age > 55 years with no menses for 12 or more months without an alternative medical cause, or b) Age ≤ 55 years with no menses for 12 or more months without an alternative medical cause AND an FSH level >40 IU/L, or c) Permanent surgical sterility (bilateral oophorectomy, bilateral salpingectomy or hysterectomy).
15)	 Any other condition that might reduce the chance of obtaining data required by the protocol or that might compromise the ability to give truly informed consent.
16)	 Participation in an investigational drug or device trial within 14 days prior to enrollment or within five times the half-life of the investigational agent in the other clinical study, if known. 
17)	 Previous combination treatment with azacitidine and Venetoclax.
18)	Subject has received allogeneic HSCT or solid organ transplantation.

In case of MDS
1)	Therapy related MDS.
2)	Any IPSS-R score other than: high or very high.

In case of CMML
1)	Therapy related disease.
2)	Patients with white blood cell count > 13000/µL.
3)	Any CPSS score other than: intermediate-2 or high.
